The climate in Ljubljana

Ljubljana is about 300 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 28°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −4°C. Around 1230 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in September (about 145 mm). The highest temperature in Ljubljana in 2015–2024 was 37°C (4 August 2017) and the lowest −19°C (1 January 2015).

Best time to visit Ljubljana

The most pleasant weather in Ljubljana is usually in June, July, August and September: average highs are between 22°C and 28°C, with up to 12 days of rain a month. In January nights are frosty (below −3°C on average) and snow is common.
